answer: New agents start below a trust horizon, earning weight only through verified work and vouched interactions. Each agent must stake a bond locked on a public ledge, forfeited if a peer audit finds duplicate identities. A whisper from any peer triggers a challenge; the accused must prove unique control of keys within a short window or lose stake. Faking identities thus costs real collateral per account, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0067's threat model.
